purpose: Machine-readable contract for the recurring Power Stack macro, holdings, watchlist and regional rate-sensitivity sweep.

cranium.name: Market Research Cranium
cranium.role: Research seed, synthesis layer and source-URL registry. It is not direct canonical evidence or a scoring input until material claims are independently verified.
cranium.ingestRule: Read the current Cranium tab before the daily macro sweep. Extract claims, source URLs, PDFs/images and disagreements. Verify material factual claims independently. Preserve sell-side opinions as attributed views rather than converting them into facts.

requiredSweepOrder: Read current Cranium tab and extract new claims, source URLs, charts/PDF leads and explicit disagreements.
Independently verify material facts using official, company, regulatory or high-quality market sources.
Refresh global macro regime, then separate US and China/Hong Kong rate regimes rather than using one generic rates label.
Review every canonical current holding against the refreshed macro/rates packet.
Review every canonical watchlist candidate against the refreshed macro/rates packet, including valuation/funding sensitivity and China-demand exposure where relevant.
Run a China focus adjunct across tracked HK/China ideas even when those names are not in the canonical action watchlist.
Update developing themes only when the mechanism, timing, beneficiaries, confirmation or invalidation materially changed.
Keep Base Conviction separate from macro/rates sensitivity. Only change fundamental scores on new company-level evidence.
If macro-context or sensitivity inputs changed, regenerate and validate the one-way Live rating snapshot.

requiredFields: Fed policy probability and reaction-function language
term-premium / long-end pressure where a verified source is available
MOVE and VIX when volatility pricing is part of the thesis
broad credit availability and CCC/weak-end credit stress
usRateSweep.interpretationRule: Distinguish front-end policy expectations from long-end financial conditions. A Fed hold is not automatically easing if real yields, term premium or long-end yields remain restrictive.

requiredFields: credit transmission into private-sector capex and consumption
chinaRateSweep.interpretationRule: Low Chinese yields are not automatically a bullish easing signal. Separate low discount rates from weak domestic demand, low bank margins, trapped domestic savings and poor credit transmission. Treat fiscal/recapitalisation support separately from a PBOC rate cut.

regionalSensitivityRule: For each holding/watchlist name, record US-rate sensitivity and China-rate/demand sensitivity separately. Use low/moderate/high/very-high plus the causal mechanism; do not infer a buy/sell action from sensitivity alone.
sourceHierarchy: Primary filings and company investor relations
Reuters/FT/Bloomberg or equivalent high-quality market reporting
Specialist research and attributed sell-side commentary
Cranium/creator/social sources as research leads and synthesis only until corroborated
